messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up to the pinning metadata RFC: proposing a lightweight 'locality_hint' field (control-plane-only) to express a preferred ingress subgroup for a tenant's pinned model. This is strictly advisory.

samir: Short ask: can you define how resolvers must treat it? We need deterministic tie-breaker behavior and a migration plan.

elaine: Resolver behavior: only used when candidates meet capacity checks. It contributes to a tie-breaker score. Add optional integer 'preference' 1..10; default 5 if omitted. Also allow 'ramp_minutes' to smooth changeover.

matt: Validation notes: hint ids must be namespaced (prefix 'loc-'), ascii lowercase, max 32 chars. Control plane keeps registry. Reject unknown ids by default; allow_unregistered_hint=true for experiments (must generate audit event).

maria: Ops: when locality_hint flips we should honor ramp_minutes (default 10). During ramp resolvers prefer both old+new with decaying preference to avoid mass KV invalidation. Add dashboards: local-hit-rate, kv-cache-miss, p95-latency.

lina: Example rollout metadata (text): {"pin":"embed-v3","locality_hint":"loc-us-east-g1","preference":"7","ramp_minutes":"10","expires_at":"2026-12-01T00:00:00Z","telemetry_opt_in":"locality_hint"}

samir: Suggested pseudocode (text):
```
if not capacity_ok(candidate): continue
score = base_score(candidate)
if candidate.locality_id == hint.id:
  score += hint.preference * 3
else if candidate.region == hint.region:
  score += hint.preference
// apply ramp: decay old_hint weight linearly over ramp_minutes
```

matt: Important: do not allow this field to override autoscaling or capacity enforcement. It's purely a preference. Also no auto-synthesis of hints from runtime signals for now.

maria: Runbook: if local-hit-rate drops >20% after changes, roll back hint updates and investigate. We'll add rate limits on hint updates per org to prevent ripple.

ops-bot: schema-checker: new draft 'rollout-meta-v1.7-locality-hint' created in staging. Failing consumers: two legacy resolvers flagged.

elaine: Action items: matt -> schema + validator PR (reject unknown ids by default); samir -> resolver scoring + unit tests behind runtime flag; maria -> ramp/runbook + dashboards + rate-limit proposal; lina -> add e2e test for ramp_minutes. ops-bot -> re-run CI after PRs.

samir: I'll keep it opt-in and behind a feature flag until we have telemetry.

matt: PR target: Thu EOD. Validator will warn on experimental writes and refuse by default.

maria: I'll draft runbook and include suggested alert thresholds.

elaine: Goal: measurable p95 win for heavy-state tenants (target 3-6%). If we see consistent wins we can iterate on hints semantics. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
